This site runs on Cloudflare infrastructure, and its data is stored in Cloudflare’s database services. Sign-in and membership verification are provided by Discord. Mobile push notifications are relayed by the Expo push service to Apple’s or Google’s push channels. Departure reminders and heirloom messages are posted to the Discord channel configured by the relevant guild’s administrator, and those messages include your in-game nickname. Apart from what is necessary for the functions above, we do not provide your personal data to other third parties, except where required by law.

You must not use this site to impersonate any person or guild, register or claim guild identities that are not yours, post unlawful or infringing content, interfere with the operation of this site, or circumvent membership checks. Content posted by users, such as team titles and signup names, is the responsibility of the person who posted it.

Download all of your account data as a single JSON file: account profile, guild roster rows, squads you created, your signup seats, gear library and saved builds. For security, login credentials and push tokens are never included.
Deletion cannot be undone. After you submit, there is a 7-day cooling-off period during which you can cancel at any time; once it ends, your personal data is deleted or anonymized.
Export and deletion are sensitive actions; a fresh Discord authorization check is required before continuing.
Please read the consequences carefully. After you submit, a 7-day cooling-off period begins, and deletion runs automatically when it ends:

Squads you created are not deleted: the leader is unlinked so they become leaderless squads, and the creator display name is replaced with “Deleted user”; seats you hold in other people’s squads are anonymized in place.
Your gear library and saved builds, push tokens, nickname snapshots and guild roster rows are permanently deleted; once deletion runs, you are signed out on every device immediately.
Guilds themselves and guild admin passwords are unaffected: a guild does not belong to any individual account, and it is neither disbanded nor changed when you delete your account.

A few records cannot be cleared per person: messages already posted to Discord and free-text name lists on result boards remain; copies inside backups are cleared within 14 days as daily backups rotate.
Deletion is not a ban: sign in again later with the same Discord account and you will register as a brand-new account.
We recommend exporting a copy of your data before submitting the deletion.

This file is an export of your account data. account holds your profile (for oauth, only the granted scopes and last refresh time are recorded — the credential itself is never exported); guilds lists your roster row in each guild; serverNicks lists your nickname snapshot in each Discord server; carsLed lists squads you created; seats lists your signup seats; gearItems is your gear library; gearBuilds lists your saved builds; heirloom holds the deduplication state of heirloom announcements. Push tokens are device credentials: only their count and platforms are recorded, never the tokens themselves.

You can access, export or delete your personal data. Under “My data” in your Profile, you can export all of your data yourself (a fresh Discord authorization check is required; one export per 24 hours), and you can delete your account yourself: after you submit a deletion there is a 7-day cooling-off period during which you may cancel at any time; once it ends, your personal data is deleted or anonymized — squads you created become leaderless squads, seats you hold in other people’s squads are anonymized, and copies inside backups are cleared within 14 days as daily backups rotate. You may also disconnect this site’s authorization at any time in your Discord settings; once the authorization lapses, your session on this site is automatically invalidated.
